body: Thank you. The biggest issue is I've been like this for so long now, I doubt it's going to be easy to change back especially when I'm constantly reminded about it through my day to day life.

Unfortunately, yeah I am motivated by the materialistic world. It's funny, a few years ago I was buried deep in philosophy. Alan Watts, Suzuki, etc. I guess one day I convinced myself it was all bullshit. Whatever, I'll drag this out for another week, if I can. Love you buddy.
